If you follow astrology you know today (7/29) is one of the luckiest days of the year. More specifically, its lucky for recognizing what wants to expand or become bigger in your life, and finding the confidence and drive to move toward it. 

That seed of expansion might already be speaking through the ideas and downloads that refuse to leave you alone.

So today, take some time to notice:
What has been nagging at you?
What kind of insights keep pinging?
What desire do you keep circling back to?

What keeps returning may point to a shift, gift, or part of your purpose that is ready to be claimed. Once you see it, you can consciously choose to commit to it. Today’s energy is perfect for that kind of reclamation.




I did the following practice this morning, and I’m sharing it in case it supports you too:

1. Take a clearing bath I love an Epsom salt soak, but make sure it works for your body and system. You can also add herbs or flowers that resonate with you. Let the water clear away stagnant energy and old stories so you can hear yourself more clearly.

2. ASK YOURSELF 2 questions 
What am I willing to fiercely stand for?
What do I truly burn for? Beneath the noise, expectations, and surface-level wants.

You can journal, meditate, or connect with these questions however you fancy.

This practice is designed to reconnect you with your inner fire—the conviction and life force needed to initiate lasting change.

a reading for July + a new collection

When I journeyed to ask what medicine was needed for July, I received two visions. 

First, the Fae showed me someone standing in the middle of a swift river. At first, they were frightened holding onto a log tightly as the current rushed around them. Slowly, they found a better grip. Then they pulled themselves up. Eventually, they were standing on the log, expertly riding that same current that had once overwhelmed them. 

The message was: July is about committing to the way through. It’s like seeing the map from above. You know the way now. You just have to take it.



***In the full message, I share details on both visions, the relational nature of mermaid healing, and a few practical ways to work with July’s energy.***

Astrologers consider today one of the luckiest days of the year—if not the luckiest.
The Sun and Jupiter meet in Leo as the Full Moon rises in Aquarius, supporting expansion in a very rare way. But to really take advantage of it, first you have to recognize what is actually trying to expand through you.
I know this might sound like an intense mandate, but today’s energy is also so generous and momentum-building that you may feel more ready than usual to stop hesitating and jump in.
So how do you recognize it? Start by noticing what refuses to leave you alone.
What has been nagging at you? What ideas or downloads keep coming through? What desire do you keep circling back to?
Use today’s energy to look more closely. What keeps returning may be pointing toward a gift, desire, or part of your purpose that is ready to be claimed.

Happy August! This energy is not subtle.

Something around us is shifting quickly, and I think a lot of us can feel it now. It’s showing up in our bodies and daily lives as restlessness, agitation, overwhelm, urgency, exhaustion, or the sense that something is coming to a head.
 When I asked the helping spirits about the energy of this month, the guidance was surprisingly practical: we should not stare at the chaos until we lose ourselves in it, or pretend it isn’t happening.

This month shows us another way through: go within.

Reconnect with what you can uniquely hold, offer, and bring into the room. Because at some point soon, it will be needed In your family, your community, your work, and in the collective. 

If you’re feeling a little fried, it’s to be expected, and August is here to offer a little respite.
